<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 211.0764 likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~210.069 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 33 % of the base peak) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. Solving 12 C + 1.007825 H + 15.994915 O + 34.968852 Cl ≈ 210.069 Da yields the best integer solution C₈H₁₅O₄Cl (calculated neutral mass = 210.0659 Da, within ~15 ppm of the observed mass). This formula also matches the observed chlorine‑related isotopic intensity.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H15O4Cl</final_answer>
